mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in liquidity and a rise in borrowing costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which typically precedes a downturn in economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE spikes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods following two consecutive quarters of GDPC1 decline, or the correlation between GDPC1 decline and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a robust supply-side response, which typically boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO spikes and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month, coupled with a rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5%, signals a demand-side shock and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of HOUST decline and CPIAUCSL rise on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals an accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS decreases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% in a month signals strong consumer demand, which typically boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between RSAFS spikes and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
